title: Facility Access Matrix — Resort Club Memberships
content:
The facilities included in each level of Resort Club Memberships are fixed by the level. "Included" means the facility is part of the level's access; "Not included" means it is outside the level's access.

| Membership level | Fitness centre | Resort pools | Spa thermal facilities | Beach club |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fitness Club Membership | Included | Not included | Not included | Not included |
| Pool & Fitness Club Membership | Included | Included | Not included | Not included |
| Spa Club Membership | Included | Included | Included | Not included |
| Beach & Pool Club Membership | Included | Included | Not included | Included |
| Family Resort Club Membership | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Founders Resort Club Membership | Included | Included | Included | Included |

## Reading the matrix by facility

- **Fitness centre** — included at all six levels.
- **Resort pools** — included at every level except the Fitness Club Membership.
- **Spa thermal facilities** — included at the Spa Club Membership, the Family Resort Club Membership and the Founders Resort Club Membership.
- **Beach club** — included at the Beach & Pool Club Membership, the Family Resort Club Membership and the Founders Resort Club Membership.

The Family Resort Club Membership and the Founders Resort Club Membership are the two levels that include all four facilities. The Spa Club Membership and the Beach & Pool Club Membership each include three, differing in that one includes the spa thermal facilities and the other the beach club.
